# PostHog — PostHog for Startups

$50,000 in PostHog platform credits valid for 12 months, plus merch and separate partner discounts (Incident.io, Speakeasy, Chroma, Depot) the page values at $12,000.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $50,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits are valid for 12 months. |


### Not covered

- PostHog Desktop
- PostHog Slack app
- Replay Vision
- PostHog AI
- Inbox
- applications from personal email addresses, like gmail.com or outlook.com

> **Stacking:** Requires signing up to a paid (usage-billed) PostHog plan before applying.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

An extra eligibility clause beyond funding/age: 'you need to have signed up any time from Jan 1st 2023 onwards'. From September 14, 2026 credits no longer apply to PostHog AI tooling. The on-page comparison table lists the same criteria (<$5m in funding, <2 years old, Company email domain), so marketing and FAQ agree. The FAQ item 'What happens at the end of the 12 months?' is a JS accordion with no server-side answer and was not inspectable. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
